9	## Exact prepared scope
10	
11	`tools/php83/entrypoint-inventory/build.py` accepts the pinned published Noble
12	bundle and original ZIP. It is intended to inspect DEB control/data tar streams
13	without installing packages, executing hooks or extracting archive member paths.
14	Only mocked/synthetic archives have been executed in this phase.
15	
16	- Package control: maintainer scripts, full member metadata, regular file hashes,
17	  line-numbered invocation candidates with source hash and package owner identity.
18	- Package data: PHP-family files, shell scripts, executable and extensionless
19	  candidates, cron/init/default/web/php etc paths, systemd and application-configuration path candidates. Every
20	  selected bounded text is scanned, not merely etc configuration files.
21	- Absolute literal PHP target tokens are distinguished from relative targets,
22	  option-led invocations and variable/dynamic interpreters. These are regex
23	  candidates, **not shell parsing or proof of execution**. Comments, strings and
24	  package names may overmatch. Unusual command construction can still be missed.
25	- Links are recorded but never followed; all data member types are counted.
26	  Each regular member receives a candidate, oversize-unscanned or excluded
27	  disposition. The 2 MiB scan limit and per-suffix exclusions remain visible.
28	- **The original ZIP contributes a PHP-family file count only.** This is not an
29	  inventory of original-tree entrypoints or a source/package reachability join.
30	  Existing ledger/source-map/payload-report hashes identify context; their owner
31	  records are not semantically reconciled by this prepared tool.
32	
33	Traversal and duplicate normalized paths are rejected. The outer bundle,
34	original ZIP and inner DEB checksums are checked; member paths never become
35	extraction destinations. Temporary DEB/tar byte streams stay in repository-owned
36	scratch and are removed. Output is exclusive-create and cannot overwrite an
